notes: Both 'with's placed on שָׂבְעָה as its valency preposition, the second as the same rendering rewritten over the gapped parallel member (rule 25's distributed-repetition clause); competing reading gives each to its noun under rule 33.

MACULA tags לַעַג absolute (Ncmsa), so no construct relation stands between 'the scoffing' and הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים; the 'of' before 'those that are at ease' is the supplied preposition stating what that appositional nominal contributes (rule 33) rather than rule 19's chain relation, and it belongs to the substantival adjective with its predicate 'are at ease' (rules 41/46), headed on 'ease', while the article keeps only 'those that' (rule 41). The unit allocation is unaffected by which rule is cited.
Ethical dative לָּהּ left wholly unrepresented, preposition and suffix each their own unit (rule 40); 'And' before הַבּוּז is added since no conjunction morpheme stands there (rule 14).
